id: title:charlesvien:read the gateway product from the task profile

review.posthog_relevance: Adds billing-product-dependent routing and environment configuration for AI gateway selection, allowing PostHog to distinguish gateway behavior based on the billing tier of a stored user profile.
review.reason: The chunk implements the propagation of the billing product context from stored profiles into gateway selection and environment variable configuration. P1.F1.H2 and P1.F3.H4 establish the dependency of gateway product and environment variables on the billing product, while P1.F2.H3 establishes the stored profile context. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the implementation of the profile_billing_product parameter or the profile object, and the reviewer cannot independently verify the source of profile_billing_product or the profile object, and cannot distinguish whether this is a new feature or a refactor.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the profile_billing_product parameter or the profile object, only its usage. The reviewer cannot independently verify the source of profile_billing_product or the profile object, and cannot distinguish whether this is a new feature or a refactor. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds profile_billing_product parameter to resolve_sandbox_ai_product and its callers, and passes profile.billing_product from task.stored_profile.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the gateway product selection to depend on the billing product associated with a stored profile, rather than only the origin product.
